primitiveBudget: one generated slab, six fixed apertures, and four liftable polygonal false membranes
renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D single-object slab with aperture membranes
memoryRule: a strong dwell-and-return trace is geometry-neutral until release; release preserves the source cavity and grows a membrane in a different cavity; four membranes compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch presses one aperture, pushes through, returns across the source, and releases; Enter or Space performs the same deterministic trace; Delete lifts; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: shutter wall, contour orbit, and oblique volume -> Canvas 2D single slab with six apertures and false membranes
compositionRupture: staggered wall, broken orbit, and block cluster -> one asymmetrical object whose cavities carry the reading
encounterRupture: proximity visit, quorum, departure, and reversal -> continuous pressure dwell-and-return gesture
temporalRupture: remote absence, false centre, and depth error -> release-time membrane that seals an untouched chamber
mediumRupture: hinged planes, contour loops, and WebGL solids -> layered Canvas 2D silhouette, cavities, and polygon membranes
changedRule: Pressure at one aperture is reconstructed as a false membrane in another aperture, while the source and all base cavities remain exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a single hollow slab. A valid pressure dwell and return grows an actual polygonal membrane in another cavity; four false seals persist and can be lifted.
falsifier: Delete if weak or one-way pressure commits, if the source cavity changes, if membranes are cosmetic, if all gestures coincide, if later memory resets, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v045 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish pressure membrane from v042-v044 or if the return event is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
